name: player_apply_status_meter_change
description: Player::ApplyStatusMeterChange replaces or adds to the player status meter, clamps it to health bounds, updates the global ratio, and refreshes the HUD shield meter.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through native Player status-meter tests.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43b5d0 validates saveState->playerState access, mode-controlled replace/add behavior, clamping statusMeterValue to [0, masterCommonData->maxHealth], computing g_PlayerStatusMeterRatio from masterCommonData->invMaxHealth, and forwarding that ratio to HudUiMgrSensor::SetShieldMessageRatio.
The native Player status-meter smoke verifies replace, additive max clamp, min clamp, global ratio updates, and HUD shield text/fill updates.
